title: Classic Beef & Rice Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 large bell peppers (green, red, or yellow), tops sliced off and seeded
1 lb lean ground beef or ground turkey
1 cup cooked white or brown rice
1 small yellow onion, finely diced & 2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce + 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, salt & black pepper
1 cup shredded mozzarella or Monterey Jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Parboil or steam the hollowed bell peppers for 4 minutes until slightly tender, then drain upside down.
Brown the ground beef or turkey with diced onion and garlic in a skillet over medium-high heat; drain excess fat.
Stir in cooked rice, half of the tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; simmer 3 minutes.
Spoon the meat-and-rice filling into the bell peppers, top with remaining tomato sauce, cover with foil, and bake 35 minutes. Uncover, top with mozzarella, and bake 10 minutes more until bubbly.
